hypothesis: Increasing only the planner output budget from 256 to 512 tokens will prevent the observed reasoning-induced JSON truncation and allow the complete validation benchmark to run while satisfying every frozen retrieval, quality, false-positive, recovery, latency, and cost guardrail.

variants.description: Frozen metadata-aware dense retrieval with one original query.
Planner v2 with the output budget increased from 256 to 512 tokens.

singleChangedVariable: Gemini planner maxOutputTokens: 256 in v2 versus 512 in v3. All semantic prompts, recovery behavior, retrieval settings, labels, and selection thresholds are unchanged.

agenticPolicy.assessor: deterministic minimum-score and requested-language coverage gate

planner.nonEmptyInvalidResponseAction: Make one formatting-only call that receives the malformed output and must preserve its query meaning.
planner.emptyResponseAction: Repeat the exact original structured request once.
planner.secondInvalidOutputAction: Fail the experiment without coercion or another retry.

agenticPolicy.merge: deduplicate by chunk id, retain highest cosine score, then stable score ordering

selectionRule.decision: Select the agentic variant only if every threshold and guardrail passes on the complete sample; otherwise retain the single-pass baseline without tuning on observed failures.

preExecutionEvidence.plannerV2Failure: Both the initial response and controlled recovery ended with MAX_TOKENS under a 256-token output budget.
preExecutionEvidence.observedTokenUse: The failed initial call used 147 reasoning and 93 visible completion tokens; recovery used 242 reasoning tokens and emitted only 10 visible tokens.
preExecutionEvidence.rationale: 512 is the smallest allowed doubled budget and exceeds both observed reasoning-plus-visible-output totals without changing reasoning effort or semantic instructions.

limitations: The validation and focused comparative sets have informed earlier retrieval experiments.
A larger output budget may increase cost even when visible JSON remains short.
A recovered response may differ from malformed output despite the formatting-only instruction.
Language coverage is a proxy for evidence sufficiency rather than semantic entailment.
